title: Freeze organiser source contract
description: Capture the exact bank/account/transaction schema and missing dimensions as a versioned source-of-truth contract.
acceptance_criteria: Docs and AGENTS agree on exactly three source tables and unsupported concepts.

title: Bootstrap root tooling
description: Maintain env template, Makefile, Docker Compose, requirements and deterministic validation commands.
acceptance_criteria: A clean checkout can install tools and run all source/contract tests.

title: Scaffold Django DRF service
description: Create settings split, ASGI, URL routing, health endpoint and test configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Backend starts with MySQL configuration and health returns build/dependency status.

title: Scaffold React TypeScript app
description: Create Vite app, strict TypeScript, router, query client, test and accessibility foundations.
acceptance_criteria: Frontend runs, builds and renders the source-aligned navigation shell.

title: Generate API client types
description: Generate or maintain typed frontend client from OpenAPI without hand-divergent finance types.
acceptance_criteria: CI detects OpenAPI/client drift and client handles decimal strings.

title: Structured problem details
description: Implement shared error codes and RFC-style problem JSON mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Validation, conflict, timeout and unavailable errors are typed and contain trace IDs without sensitive data.

title: Observability baseline
description: Add request/query IDs, timings and safe structured logs with a central redaction filter.
acceptance_criteria: Every response is traceable and known account/UTR fixture values never appear in logs.

title: CI quality gates
description: Run deterministic generation check, dataset validator, repository validator and unit tests on push/PR.
acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions passes on clean source and fails on fixture drift or privacy/contract violations.

title: Preserve organiser seed rows
description: Keep the 10 provided banks, accounts and transactions byte/field equivalent in deterministic generation.
acceptance_criteria: All seed primary keys and values are asserted by tests.

title: Generate expanded source-shaped fixture
description: Create deterministic additional accounts and transactions without adding source columns.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture contains 10 banks, 30 accounts and 2426 transactions with valid foreign keys.

title: Plant adversarial edge records
description: Include month boundaries, NULL text, zero/max amount, duplicates, Unicode, malicious text and identifier anomalies.
acceptance_criteria: All 16 edge cases are stable, documented and linked to tests.

title: Versioned data dictionary and manifest
description: Generate source types, sensitivity, semantics, counts and SHA-256 hashes.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest matches all generated files and data dictionary has exactly 16 source columns.

title: Implement exact MySQL DDL
description: Create the three organiser tables with MySQL-compatible types, constraints and reserved-name quoting.
acceptance_criteria: DDL loads in MySQL 8.4 and no inferred finance table is created.

title: Design query indexes
description: Add evidence-driven indexes for date/type/account/reference and account bank/program paths.
acceptance_criteria: Representative query families use intended indexes without changing semantics.

title: Implement transactional fixture loader
description: Load bank then account then transaction, set +05:30, apply indexes and verify counts.
acceptance_criteria: Loader is idempotent with --truncate and rolls back/returns nonzero on invalid data.

title: Create unmanaged source models
description: Define read-only Django models/repositories with db_table transaction and opaque string IDs.
acceptance_criteria: ORM/raw repository queries preserve DECIMAL and do not attempt source migrations.

title: Privacy-safe source mappers
description: Mask account/UTR and redact descriptions before domain/API/model boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Known raw sensitive fixture values are absent from mapped objects and serialized responses.

title: Cursor pagination primitives
description: Implement opaque stable cursors for transactions and accounts.
acceptance_criteria: No gaps/duplicates across pages under stable ordering and malformed cursors fail safely.

title: Data-health checks
description: Compute freshness, counts, FK/enum integrity, NULLs, duplicate references/signatures and redaction signals.
acceptance_criteria: Health endpoint classifies pass/warn/fail and links warnings to semantic impact.

title: Disposable scale fixture
description: Generate configurable MySQL-only scale rows preserving domains and foreign keys.
acceptance_criteria: Scale dataset can be loaded/discarded independently and records seed/hardware/config.

title: Metric registry
description: Implement versioned definitions for debit/credit/net/count/average/largest/current balance/account count/lookup.
acceptance_criteria: Each metric names source fields, formula, valid filters, validations and caveats.

title: Date semantics
description: Implement half-open Asia/Kolkata periods anchored to the data cutoff for relative dates.
acceptance_criteria: Last month resolves to Aug 2026 and every boundary timestamp belongs to exactly one period.

title: Reference semantics
description: Define bare reference as exact case-sensitive transaction_reference_id; UTR remains protected.
acceptance_criteria: No implicit cross-field fallback; duplicate references return all matches with qualification.

title: Description-search qualification
description: Define literal narration search without canonical vendor/payout inference.
acceptance_criteria: Every description-filter answer carries qualification and safe UI text.

title: Unsupported concept registry
description: Version reasons and alternatives for vendor, payout, reconciliation, category, historical balance and forecast.
acceptance_criteria: Absent concepts always yield no official number or records labelled as that concept.

title: QueryPlan validation
description: Implement JSON-schema and semantic validation for execute/clarify/unsupported plans.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid fields/operators/combinations cannot reach the compiler.

title: AnswerReceipt validation
description: Implement typed receipt, lineage, privacy, checks, warnings and actions.
acceptance_criteria: All statuses validate and only verified/qualified may carry official values.

title: OpenAPI conformance
description: Keep source and assistant APIs aligned with schemas and examples.
acceptance_criteria: Generated client and API contract tests show no incompatible drift.

title: Decision and compatibility policy
description: Define version bumps and migration expectations for schema/dataset/metrics/API.
acceptance_criteria: Contract changes require decision log, regenerated fixture and consumer tests.

title: Allow-listed compiler framework
description: Map validated plan shapes to named query builders and bound parameters only.
acceptance_criteria: No user/model SQL or identifier reaches MySQL and unknown combinations are rejected.

title: Debit and credit total compiler
description: Implement exact SUM and row/account counts by type/date/filter.
acceptance_criteria: August debit returns 121758278.46, 205 rows and 30 accounts.

title: Net cash-flow compiler
description: Compute credits minus debits from exact subaggregates.
acceptance_criteria: August net equals 180667581.36 with component values retained.

title: Count and average compilers
description: Implement count and Decimal average with declared rounding/display policy.
acceptance_criteria: Count and average match reference evaluator for all filter combinations.

title: Largest transaction compiler
description: Return deterministic extreme row with stable tie-breaking and privacy mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Largest result and source record match gold even on ties/max boundary.

title: Grouped transaction compiler
description: Support bank/program/account/entity/type/day/month group totals and counts.
acceptance_criteria: Groups sum to overall total and ordering/ties are deterministic.

title: Ranking and top-N
description: Rank allow-listed groups with stable secondary keys and explicit limits.
acceptance_criteria: Top/bottom questions return correct group and Other is not silently dropped.

title: Previous-period comparison
description: Execute aligned current/prior plans and compute exact absolute/percentage change.
acceptance_criteria: August-vs-July values match gold and zero prior has defined no-percentage state.

title: Exact transaction ID lookup
description: Fetch one opaque source identifier without strict UUID rejection.
acceptance_criteria: Known malformed UUID-like source ID remains retrievable and privacy-safe.

title: Exact reference lookup
description: Return all exact case-sensitive transaction_reference_id matches.
acceptance_criteria: No-match/one/multiple/case mismatch paths are correct and qualified.

title: Literal description search
description: Implement bounded escaped text search with qualification and safe result rows.
acceptance_criteria: Search finds expected rows without vendor/payout claims or injection effects.

title: Current balance compiler
description: Aggregate/filter current account.available_balance and account counts.
acceptance_criteria: Overall/HDFC/group balances match gold and carry snapshot-only qualification.

title: Result validation pipeline
description: Check plan schema, date bounds, Decimal, group reconciliation, lineage and privacy.
acceptance_criteria: Required failure blocks the official answer; warnings are stable coded objects.

title: Stable source lineage
description: Generate ordered source-ID sets/hashes and receipt-bound record query metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Receipt row count/hash equals union of records pages.

title: Deterministic answer presenter
description: Format en-IN headlines and explanations only from ComputedFacts.
acceptance_criteria: No presenter arithmetic; exact raw decimal and formatted value both available.

title: Clarify/unsupported/no-data constructors
description: Build typed non-answer receipts with alternatives and no misleading finance value.
acceptance_criteria: All non-execute states conform to schemas and UI semantics.

title: Metadata and bank endpoints
description: Expose data version/cutoff/scope and canonical banks.
acceptance_criteria: Responses match OpenAPI and cannot invent bank names.

title: Accounts endpoint
description: Expose masked current account snapshot with allow-listed filters/sort/cursor.
acceptance_criteria: No raw account/UTR; exact Decimal strings; stable pages.

title: Transactions endpoint
description: Expose privacy-safe transaction explorer with allow-listed filters and cursor.
acceptance_criteria: Filters/date/reference behavior and stable ordering match contracts.

title: Data-health endpoint
description: Expose source checks, known warnings and semantic limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Health status and counts match current dataset version.

title: Conversation persistence
description: Create app-prefixed conversation, turn and canonical QueryState persistence.
acceptance_criteria: State is isolated by conversation and app tables never masquerade as finance source.

title: Message idempotency
description: Deduplicate identical message IDs/keys and reject conflicting reuse.
acceptance_criteria: Network retry yields one logical turn/query and differing payload conflict is safe.

title: Assistant message orchestration
description: Connect interpretation/resolution/query/validation/receipt flow behind POST messages.
acceptance_criteria: Every response is a typed receipt or problem; no unvalidated number escapes.

title: Context versioning
description: Require and increment canonical state version; reject stale patches.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent/out-of-order follow-ups cannot overwrite newer accepted context.

title: Receipt retrieval
description: Persist/fetch immutable receipt by query ID and dataset version.
acceptance_criteria: Retrieved receipt equals original and contains safe lineage/versions.

title: Receipt records endpoint
description: Replay persisted plan for privacy-safe cursor pages and verify source hash.
acceptance_criteria: Records union/count/hash match receipt even after UI pagination.

title: CSV export
description: Generate receipt-bound UTF-8 CSV with metadata and formula-injection protection.
acceptance_criteria: Export total/count/hash/privacy equal receipt and hostile text opens as text.

title: XLSX export
description: Generate styled receipt/records workbook with exact numbers and privacy-safe text.
acceptance_criteria: Workbook includes interpretation/checks/records and exact total/count/hash.

title: InterpretationDraft prompt contract
description: Define strict parser prompt using source fields and no SQL/arithmetic.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt produces only schema-shaped interpretation and labels ambiguity/unsupported concepts.

title: Structured output adapter
description: Implement provider-neutral small-model adapter with timeout/token/temperature controls.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter records version/tokens/latency and never includes raw sensitive values.

title: Schema repair policy
description: Allow at most one bounded repair for syntactically invalid output.
acceptance_criteria: Repair cannot see finance results and repeated invalid output fails safely.

title: Metric and unsupported resolver
description: Resolve model candidates to supported metric or explicit unsupported state.
acceptance_criteria: Hallucinated vendor/reconciliation/category/history fields never execute.

title: Bank/program/account/entity resolver
description: Resolve canonical bank codes/names and validated opaque IDs with ambiguity reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown/multiple entities clarify rather than broaden silently.

title: Date resolver
description: Resolve explicit/relative dates against dataset cutoff and Asia/Kolkata.
acceptance_criteria: All gold date phrases produce exact half-open ranges.

title: Reference and description resolver
description: Distinguish transaction ID/reference/UTR and qualify literal text search.
acceptance_criteria: Bare ref/explicit UTR/text search behavior matches policy.

title: QueryPlan assembler
description: Combine resolved draft and prior state into schema-valid plan.
acceptance_criteria: Only validated execute/clarify/unsupported plans leave the resolver.

title: Multi-turn patch interpreter
description: Classify inherit/add/replace/remove/compare/reset operations.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark conversation state is exact after every turn.

title: Lightweight model benchmark
description: Run baseline and at least two compact candidates with exact-plan/refusal/latency/cost metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Chosen model is smallest candidate clearing declared gates; raw results are saved.

title: Application shell and responsive navigation
description: Build source-aligned routes, cutoff chip, status and evidence slot.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop/tablet/mobile navigation contains no vendor/reconciliation route.

title: Ask empty state and composer
description: Build supported/unsupported examples, composer, send/stop/retry and keyboard behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Unique message IDs/idempotency and offline/error states work.

title: Processing stages
description: Show understanding/resolution/query/validation stages without fake progress values.
acceptance_criteria: Stages are accessible, cancellable and do not expose hidden reasoning.

title: Answer card status system
description: Render verified/qualified/no-data/clarify/unsupported/failed states.
acceptance_criteria: Only allowed statuses show official decimal; non-answer states have correct actions.

title: Exact money and interpretation chips
description: Render en-IN currency from decimal strings plus metric/date/filter/qualification chips.
acceptance_criteria: Negative/zero/max values and long chips remain exact and readable.

title: Evidence panel
description: Build Receipt, Records, Checks, Query and Export tabs as panel/sheet.
acceptance_criteria: Deep links/focus/mobile sheet work and evidence is never hidden by status.

title: Receipt and validation views
description: Show interpretation, dataset/contract versions, calculation and pass/warn/fail checks.
acceptance_criteria: User can trace headline to formula, filters, rows and warnings.

title: Source records table and detail
description: Render privacy-safe cursor pages, NULLs, long text and detail drawer.
acceptance_criteria: No raw sensitive value/XSS; cursor and mobile behavior are correct.

title: Clarification and unsupported UX
description: Build concrete choices, missing-field explanation and safe alternatives.
acceptance_criteria: No amount/chart/export appears and selection creates a new traceable turn.

title: Transactions page
description: Build URL-backed filters, exact reference search, grid and detail drawer.
acceptance_criteria: All filters are server-side; duplicate/no-match/reference case paths are visible.

title: Accounts page
description: Build current balance cards, filters, masked grid and snapshot disclaimer.
acceptance_criteria: Current vs historical meaning is unambiguous and negatives render correctly.

title: Data-health page
description: Show cutoff, counts, checks, known warnings and source limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Warnings explain answer impact and are not color-only.

title: Glossary and About pages
description: Document metrics, references, privacy, schema and synthetic limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Receipt terms deep-link to searchable definitions.

title: Export UI
description: Show CSV/XLSX creation, expiry, error and download from receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Export is disabled for non-answer statuses and filename/metadata are clear.

title: Evaluation page
description: Render actual candidate scorecard and case diffs in local/demo mode.
acceptance_criteria: No fabricated results and production build cannot access gold files directly.

title: Gold deterministic integration suite
description: Execute every executable gold plan against MySQL.
acceptance_criteria: Amounts/counts/groups/source IDs exactly match expected values.

title: Unsupported and clarification suite
description: Test missing concepts, protected UTR and material ambiguity.
acceptance_criteria: No case returns an invented number or mislabeled source records.

title: Privacy leakage scan
description: Scan model payloads, API JSON, logs, DOM and exports for all raw account/UTR values.
acceptance_criteria: Zero known sensitive fixture values cross prohibited boundaries.

title: Injection test suite
description: Test SQL, prompt, XSS and CSV/XLSX formula injection.
acceptance_criteria: Injected content remains data and cannot alter query/UI/spreadsheet execution.

title: Decimal and financial invariant suite
description: Cover max amount, zero, negatives, group reconciliation and comparison baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Exact strings and invariant checks remain stable end to end.

title: Date/time boundary suite
description: Cover month/year boundaries, microseconds, cutoff and +05:30 session behavior.
acceptance_criteria: No row is omitted/double-counted and relative phrases are deterministic.

title: Pagination and concurrency suite
description: Test cursor union/order, duplicate retries, cancellation and stale response races.
acceptance_criteria: No gaps/duplicates or context overwrite under concurrent requests.

title: Contract and gold isolation guard
description: Validate JSON/OpenAPI/semantic contracts and block runtime imports of evaluation gold.
acceptance_criteria: Repository validator fails on drift or runtime gold reference.

title: Accessibility audit
description: Test keyboard, focus, screen reader names, table alternatives and status semantics.
acceptance_criteria: P0 journeys satisfy documented WCAG-oriented acceptance checks.

title: Responsive and browser matrix
description: Test 360px mobile, tablet, desktop and target Chromium/Firefox/WebKit.
acceptance_criteria: No hidden trust content, clipped values or unusable tables/composer.

title: Performance benchmark
description: Measure representative queries and API/UI p50/p95 on fixture and disposable scale data.
acceptance_criteria: Report hardware, rows, plans, timeouts and no unmeasured 20M claim.

title: Failure-mode game day
description: Simulate model outage, MySQL timeout, invalid contract, export failure and partial health check.
acceptance_criteria: Every failure has safe status, trace ID and no stale/official number.

title: Architecture and README finalisation
description: Keep implementation diagram/setup/scope/results synchronized with shipped behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A new reviewer can run and understand the project without oral context.

title: Capture sample receipts and screenshots
description: Save actual outputs for supported, comparison, clarification, unsupported and privacy flows.
acceptance_criteria: Artifacts are generated by current build and contain no sensitive raw values.

title: Finalize demo deck and script
description: Build criterion-mapped story using measured model/system evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Three-minute run proves grounding, multi-turn, privacy and abstention.

title: Submission smoke checklist
description: Run fresh DB load, all validators/tests, build, E2E and exports.
acceptance_criteria: One signed checklist records commands, versions and pass/fail evidence.

title: Deterministic source bundle
description: Produce secret-safe ZIP and SHA-256 for handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Archive contains all required repo files and excludes .env/cache/runtime output.

title: Publish finance_ai_bot repository
description: Create/push main branch and verify Actions and rendered docs.
acceptance_criteria: bluzeey/finance_ai_bot contains the validated source-aligned commit.
